guarantees.claim: process_latched is cleared to 0 when reset (rst_ni low) is asserted.
process_latched is set to 1 when process_i is high and no reset is active.
process_latched is cleared to 0 when process_i is low and done_i passes mubi4_test_true_strict.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni high, process_i false, and mubi4_test_true_strict(done_i) returns true

guarantees.claim: process_latched holds its previous value when none of the explicit update conditions apply.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni high, process_i false, and mubi4_test_true_strict(done_i) false

assumptions.claim: done_i must be a correctly encoded mubi4 signal such that mubi4_test_true_strict reliably identifies the true state.
assumptions.risk: If done_i is corrupted or has an invalid mubi4 encoding, the strict true test may fail, preventing process_latched from being cleared when completion occurs.

uncertain_points.claim: When process_i and done_i are asserted simultaneously, the priority logic sets process_latched to 1 and ignores done_i. It is unclear whether the specification intends done_i to always clear the latch or only when no new request is pending.
uncertain_points.risk: If done_i is expected to unconditionally clear the latch to indicate completion, this priority order could cause a stuck process_latched, deadlocking the control flow.
